narr: Ahead of a southeast moving cold front, a west to east oriented band of heavy precipitation formed across central Kentucky along a boundary remaining from precipitation from the previous night. As rain continued along this boundary, areas of flash flooding occurred in Nelson County.||Later in the day, a report of flooding was received from Simpson County as the cold front worked its way through south central Kentucky.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Old Bloomfield Pike and North 3rd Street.
Caney Fork Road was impassable due to water over the roadway.
There was a water rescue on North 3rd Street. The street was closed due to high water. Flood waters reached the front porch of a home on Andrea Court.
Debris was left on Middleton Circle Road from earlier flooding. Water was also over 100 West in the same area.
